Restaurant Design Project

ELLALIS DESIGN

Every detail in this project was thoughtfully designed and developed by me. It reflects my personal vision and creative direction. Please refrain from using or replicating any elements without permission.

This restaurant interior design is a reflection of my personal vision and inspiration, brought to life through thoughtful spatial planning, materials, and atmosphere. Every detail—from the layout and lighting to the textures and color palette—was carefully selected to create a harmonious, inviting environment where aesthetics meet functionality.

modules.altText: Image may contain: furniture and indoor

modules.text:
The foundation of this project is not only design, but a reimagining of the space's concept.
 It involves the full transformation of a building that once served as a kindergarten into a contemporary restaurant concept.

modules.altText: Image may contain: wall, furniture and indoor

modules.text: The project was developed entirely from scratch, with a fresh design vision, and the full space was completed within four months.
Detailed measurements and site analysis were conducted prior to concept development, resulting in a new design that combines comfort and modern aesthetics.

modules.altText: Image may contain: bottle and indoor
Image may contain: indoor and curtain

modules.text:
These visuals convey the expected atmosphere and feeling of the future environment.
 They allow for early evaluation of space, color combinations, and functional solutions, offering a clear vision before implementation.

modules.altText: Image may contain: indoor, wall and curtain

modules.text: Design is not only about aesthetics, but about shaping experiences and emotions within a space.

"In this design, nothing is accidental. Every curve, every texture, every light and shadow has been intentionally placed to serve a purpose — to tell a story, to awaken a feeling, to create harmony between space and soul. Each detail carries a part of my vision, carefully crafted not only with skill, but with meaning."

modules.altText: Image may contain: indoor, vase and wedding

modules.text: Please pay special attention to the chandeliers featured in this project — their design and 3D modeling are entirely based on my original concept. Every form, material, and proportion was developed from scratch, reflecting a fresh idea brought to life through creative vision and technical precision.

modules.altText: Image may contain: indoor, wedding and wedding dress
Image may contain: curtain and indoor

modules.text: The curtains embrace the restaurant’s interior with elegance and softness, like a quiet whisper that completes the space. They are not just decorative elements — they move with light, filter emotion, and add a subtle rhythm to the atmosphere.

modules.altText: Image may contain: art and lamp
Image may contain: bathroom, sink and shower
Image may contain: furniture, couch and indoor

modules.text:
Thank you for exploring this project. Every detail was crafted with care, intention, and deep creative thought. This design reflects my personal vision, and I kindly ask that it not be copied or reproduced without permission.

This project is more than design — it’s a piece of my creative soul. I hope it inspired you, just as it inspired me while bringing it to life.

Please respect the originality of the work and feel free to reach out for collaboration.

ELLALIS DESIGN

It’s been a pleasure sharing my work with you. 
I am eager to bring fresh ideas to life in new projects.
